# SetTime

Last updated: 2026-09-13

> Kairos.ai's construction/rebar product. Shipping today: rebar estimation automation that turns a structural drawing into shop drawings and a material-list workbook. AR field guidance and AI as-built verification are later modules on the same roadmap, in development. Built for the Taiwanese construction market (營造/鋼筋施工).

## Product

- [Rebar Estimation Automation System](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#product): Shipping today. An AutoCAD 2021 plugin plus a cross-platform desktop app that converts structural drawings directly into shop drawings and a material-list workbook (.xlsm), importing natively into a fabricator's existing macro tooling, with beam/column recognition meeting acceptance thresholds.
- [AR field guidance + AI verification](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#solution): In development. 3D rebar layout overlaid on formwork (green = correct placement, red = deviation), and computer-vision comparison of as-built vs. as-designed rebar before the pour.
- [Law & compliance / audit trail](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#compliance): In development. Every pipeline action will be written to a SHA-256 hash-chained, append-only, UTC-timestamped log with monotonic sequence numbers — tamper-evident (detects alteration), not a compliance certification. Built for large-contractor and government-tender audit review; actual compliance obligations depend on applicable law and contract terms, and the page carries a legal disclaimer to that effect.
- [Free pilot program](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#pilot): Construction companies, rebar fabricators, and structural engineering firms can apply for a free pilot — company name, email, and construction type.

## FAQ

- What is SetTime? SetTime is Kairos.ai's construction/rebar product. What's shipping today is rebar estimation automation: it turns structural drawings into shop drawings and material-list data for estimation and fabrication. AR field guidance and AI as-built verification are later modules on the same product roadmap, in development.
- What can SetTime do today? The Rebar Estimation Automation System is shipping now (see Product above); AR field guidance, AI as-built verification, and the law/compliance audit trail are in development.
- Does the audit trail guarantee legal compliance? No — and this feature is still in development. It is a technical tamper-evidence mechanism (SHA-256 hash chain); it does not certify compliance with any specific law, regulation, or tender requirement. Actual compliance depends on applicable law and contract terms — this is not legal advice.
- Who is SetTime for? Construction companies, rebar fabricators, structural engineering firms, and public agencies that need an auditable as-built record.
- How do I apply for the free pilot? Fill in the free pilot form at https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#pilot with company name, email, and construction type.
- Who builds SetTime? Kairos.ai, focused on Taiwan's construction market and rebar work today, with plans to extend into adjacent trades like CNC machining, mold making, and welding.

## Notes

- The product page supports 8 languages (繁體中文 default, plus English, 日本語, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, and Português switchers) — content above reflects the English version.
- Target market: Taiwan construction — CNC machining, mold making, welding, auto repair, plumbing, and sheet metal shops are adjacent verticals in the broader roadmap, but rebar/structural construction is the current focus.
